name: 看火的老人
src: 月银纪史诗/第一歌_灰桥初火.md:821
gear: 灵格（LVL 70）｜贫｜不打仗｜1档｜页上写他本事在眼睛上、打不了兽；祭火没有国也几乎没有铁，只给毡袍外缝一块厚皮护胸，手里是缠银片的杖和削银的旧铁刀，写 battle_pose
who: The fire-watcher of Grey Bridge, a human sorcerer of the far north and the oldest person under the bridge, about eighty; nobody remembers his name: about 170 cm, thin and bent like a dry stick, but his hands are still steady. Long uncombed white hair and a long white beard tied at the chest with a strip of hide. Deep-set eyes of a pale clear teal that seem to look straight through the ice at a river flowing underneath, the lids heavy and red-rimmed from forty nights without sleep. A weathered, deeply lined face. Around his neck on a thong hangs one last flake of shaved pale silver, thin enough to see light through. He looks behind people before he looks at them. A slow, patient, stubborn air. No other jewellery, no glasses.
face: FACE, as in the references: a very old man's long, hollow-cheeked face, deep lines across the forehead and around the eyes, heavy red-rimmed lids over deep-set pale teal eyes, bushy white eyebrows, a long white beard and moustache that hide most of the mouth, a thin straight nose; skin shadows a cool pale grey-pink.
build: 170 cm, thin and stooped: narrow bony shoulders, long thin arms, knotted steady hands.
palette: bone-white hair, pale teal, smoke-brown wolf fur, walnut-dyed felt, cold pale silver
casual: His fire-watcher's clothes: a long walnut-brown felt robe to the shins that closes straight down the front with bone toggles, fitted sleeves, a ragged grey wolf-fur mantle over the shoulders, leg wraps and feet bound in layers of hide strips; at his belt a small leather pouch heavy with broken silver and, in a hide sheath, a worn blade of old iron scavenged from the fallen-god ruins; a tall knotted staff of fire-hardened wood in his right hand. He stands slightly stooped, looking past the viewer's shoulder.
private: Resting for once, which he almost never does: the wolf-fur mantle wrapped round him like a blanket and held closed with one hand, the brown felt robe underneath, hide-bound feet; in the other hand he holds a paper-thin flake of pale silver up to the light and squints through it. A tired, gentle look.
battle: Keeping the fire through the beast siege, in the little a ruin-age sorcerer owns: the walnut-brown felt robe belted tight under a thick hide chest guard sewn on the outside, the wolf-fur mantle knotted at the throat, leg wraps and hide-bound feet, the pouch of broken silver at the belt. In his right hand the tall knotted staff, its head wound with a band of shaved pale-silver flakes that burn with a cold white light; in his left the old iron scraper-blade, a dull ember glow along its edge and a paper-thin silver flake caught on it. He does not fight; he holds his watch, unmoving, the mouth set.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, standing his watch stooped but unmoving, the knotted staff with its cold white silver-wrapped head held upright in one hand and the old iron scraper-blade in the other, a stubborn, sleepless look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the fire-handing at first snow: his cleanest felt robe brushed and belted with a rawhide thong, a white wolf pelt laid evenly over both shoulders, the beard combed and tied with fresh hide; on a cord at his chest the soot-blackened little clay fire-pot, a rime of white frost on its mouth and an ember glowing inside. The knotted staff held upright beside him. He stands as straight as he can, grave and quiet.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale teal eyes looking just past the viewer as if at something flowing behind them, tired and kind, the mouth hidden in the beard. Cold white light from a pale-silver fire below lights the underside of his face; deep blue night behind. Foreground blur: a paper-thin silver flake catching the light and drifting snow.

name: 迪安
src: 月银纪史诗/第一歌_灰桥初火.md:836
gear: 共鸣（LVL 38）｜贫｜不打仗｜1档｜接骨匠，兽潮那几夜抱着两个孩子坐在火最里头，不出去打；祭火又穷，毡袍外头只缝一块厚皮护胸，手里是缠碎银的火把和夹板，写 battle_pose
who: Dian, a human bone-setter of the far north, about fifty, the second-oldest person under Grey Bridge and Miah's father: about 180 cm, big-framed and heavy-handed, broad shoulders gone a little round, thick strong fingers that set a bone true at the first pull, knuckles red and chapped from the cold. Short-cropped hair of a faded dusty rose going grey at the temples, a short rough beard of the same colour streaked with grey. Deep steel-blue eyes under heavy brows, a scowl line worn into the forehead. He swears before he sets a bone and says 'there, now clear off' after. A gruff, short-tempered, quietly tender air. No jewellery, no glasses.
face: FACE, as in the references: a weathered man's face of about fifty, a heavy brow with a deep scowl line between the eyebrows, deep-set steel-blue eyes, thick greying rose-brown eyebrows, a broad nose, a short rough greying beard, a mouth pressed in a flat line, faint lines at the corners of the eyes; skin shadows a warm ruddy pink.
build: 180 cm, big-framed: broad, slightly rounded shoulders, a thick chest, heavy forearms and big strong hands.
palette: faded rose and grey hair, steel blue, walnut-brown felt, rabbit-fur cream, bear-grease amber
casual: His bone-setter's clothes: a knee-length felt robe dyed brown with walnut husk, closing straight down the centre front with bone toggles, fitted sleeves rolled to the elbow, a rabbit-fur collar; wool trousers, leg wraps and hide-strip-bound feet; a leather satchel on a strap across the chest stuffed with clean linen strips, two birch splint-boards tucked into it; a big clay jar of bear grease sealed with beeswax held in his right hand. A gruff look, the brows drawn together.
private: Off duty by the fire: the felt robe off, a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt laced at the throat, a thick bearskin wrapped round his shoulders, wool trousers and soft hide boots; he rubs his big chapped hands together to warm them. A tired look, softened for once.
battle: Guarding the innermost ring of the fire on the night of the beast siege, in what Grey Bridge has: the walnut-brown felt robe belted hard under a thick hide chest guard sewn on the outside, the bearskin thrown over one shoulder, leather bracers, leg wraps and hide-bound feet, the satchel of splints and linen across his chest. In his right hand a short torch wrapped at the head with shards of pale silver that burn with a cold white flame, held out low; in his left a heavy birch splint-board gripped like a club. A fierce protective scowl, the mouth set.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, leaning slightly forward and planted like a wall, a short cold-white silver-wrapped torch held out low in one hand and a heavy splint-board gripped in the other, a fierce protective scowl, the mouth closed.
formal: At the spring fire-handing, when the fire passes to him: his cleanest walnut-brown felt robe brushed, a fresh rabbit-fur collar, a bearskin laid evenly over both shoulders, the beard trimmed; on a cord at his chest the soot-blackened little clay fire-pot, frost on its rim and an ember glowing inside, one big hand laid flat over it. A stern, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the steel-blue eyes looking straight at the viewer under the scowling brows, gruff but steady, the mouth set. Warm orange firelight on one side, cold blue snow light on the other. Foreground blur: a loose roll of white linen strip and drifting snow.

name: 罗伊
src: 月银纪史诗/第一歌_灰桥初火.md:850
gear: 启源（估）｜贫｜不打仗｜1档｜七岁的孩子，兽潮那几夜被迪安抱在火最里头，不打仗；只写裹严实的皮衣，手里攥着木狼和几片发冷白光的碎银，写 battle_pose
who: Roy, a human boy of seven, the youngest child under Grey Bridge and Hilda's little brother: small, about 118 cm, a slight child wholly covered by his clothes. A messy mop of ash-gold hair sticking out every way, round bright amber eyes like his sister's, always on the lookout for something new to throw into the fire. Cheeks and the tip of the nose pink-red from the cold. He carries a little wolf carved from wood by the hunter Ask. A restless, curious, mischievous air.
palette: ash gold, amber, fox russet, rabbit-fur cream, a little faded red yarn
casual: His winter clothes, handed down and too big: a small hooded fox-fur coat with the sleeves rolled up, closing down the front with bone toggles and belted with a twist of hemp cord, a thick undyed wool tunic underneath, wool leggings, hide boots wound round and round with thongs, thick wool mittens; the little carved wooden wolf held in one hand. He grins with the mouth closed, already looking for something to throw.
private: Indoors by the fire: the fur coat off, a long-sleeved undyed wool tunic to the knees with a little red yarn at the cuffs, wool leggings and thick knitted socks, the ash-gold hair sticking up; he holds the carved wooden wolf up at eye level and makes it walk through the air. A delighted, absorbed look.
battle: Bundled up for the beast siege: the hooded fox-fur coat pulled up and tied tight, a wool scarf wound up to the nose, mittens on, hide boots laced high. He clutches the carved wooden wolf to his chest with one arm and in the other fist holds up a few scraps of pale silver that shine with a cold white light. Scared but trying not to show it, the mouth shut.
battle_pose: 3) the siege outfit: a small child, not a fighter, standing with the feet together and the shoulders hunched in the hooded fur coat, the wooden wolf hugged to his chest and a fist of cold-glowing silver scraps held up, wide alert eyes, the mouth closed.
formal: At the fire-handing at first snow: a brushed small fox-fur coat closed with bone toggles, a new rabbit-fur collar, the hair combed down for once and one small tuft tied with faded red yarn, the mittens hanging on a string round his neck; he hides the carved wolf behind his back and tries very hard to stand still. A solemn little face.
art: A close head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly up, the round amber eyes looking at the viewer with mischievous curiosity, the mouth closed in a small grin. Cold white light from a pale-silver fire lights his face from below; deep blue night behind. Foreground blur: a scrap of silver glinting as it flies toward the fire, and snowflakes.

name: 不开口的牧羊人
src: 月银纪史诗/第一歌_灰桥初火.md:863
gear: 神（库米罗妮行走人世）｜—｜不打仗｜不出｜用户 11-07 定神行走人世不出战斗服，cells 只写三套；battle 一句照写备着，不出图
who: A silent shepherd woman who walked into Grey Bridge one autumn behind a few sheep; nobody can tell her age: about 168 cm, slight and quiet, always walking last, never near and never far. Short pale wheat-gold hair the colour of autumn grass, chin length, tied back with a twist of straw cord, one small braid. A young face with a calm, old, kind gaze and warm honey-brown eyes. Her face never reddens in the cold and her rag-bound feet are never frostbitten, though she is dressed far too thinly for the snow. A polished white ash-wood staff always in her hand. She never speaks; she only watches. No jewellery.
palette: autumn-grass gold, coarse undyed wool, sackcloth brown, pale ash-wood white, sheep-fleece cream
casual: A shepherd's clothes of the ruin age: a long coarse undyed wool robe to the shins closing down the front with wooden toggles, fitted sleeves, a thin cloak of coarse sackcloth-brown wool over the shoulders, a sheep fleece tied round the waist with straw rope; no boots, the feet bound in strips of torn cloth; the polished white ash-wood staff held upright in one hand. She stands quietly at the edge, the eyes lowered.
private: Apart from the fire: the sackcloth cloak off and folded over one arm, the coarse undyed robe, the rag-bound feet; she rests the white staff against her shoulder and looks off into the distance, calm and patient.
battle: She does not fight: standing at the back of the line in the snow, the sackcloth cloak pulled close, the polished white ash-wood staff raised level before her in both hands as if holding something back. Calm, the mouth closed.
formal: On the first morning of spring, when she goes: the same coarse robe brushed clean, a fresh straw cord in her hair with one green shoot tucked into it, a pale wool shawl over the shoulders, the rag-bound feet, the white staff upright. She stands still with a faint, kind smile.
art: A three-quarter portrait, the face turned slightly, the warm eyes looking at the viewer calmly and saying nothing, the mouth closed. Soft pale dawn light from behind lights the edge of the wheat-gold hair; cool snow blue all around. Foreground blur: a first green sprout pushing out of the snow, and a sheep's ear at the edge of the frame.
